about_variants:
I build AI systems where evaluation and verification matter. My projects focus on structured pipelines with measurable quality gates.

ComicMainEngine: End-to-end generative comic pipeline. Vision: automate comic creation from script to panels. Approach: FastAPI backend with multi-provider LLM and image generation. Evaluation: VLM rubric gates scoring each panel. Result: 22/22 board tasks completed.

Procedural City: 3D city generation with LLM scene direction. Vision: generate coherent urban environments under budget constraints. Approach: 92-phase pipeline with schema validation. Evaluation: structured output validation at each phase. Currently achieving 52/92 phases with spend tracking.

BeamDojo: Reproducing Isaac Lab locomotion research. Vision: train humanoid robots to walk on beams. Approach: PPO training on Lambda GPU with Isaac Sim. Evaluation: Weights and Biases metrics tracking. Currently running Stage 1 smoke tests at 18% progress.

Education: BTech CS from IIT Kharagpur, MS CS from UMass Amherst. Three years at Mastercard building payment APIs with around 20% latency improvement on Enhanced Currency Conversion.

Looking for AI and agent engineer roles focused on evaluation-first development.
